name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei Zhao's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While pursuing a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the National University of Singapore, he volunteered with a local racing team as a data analyst. The thrill of optimizing performance and the intricate dance between driver and machine ignited a passion that would shape his career. After graduating, Wei honed his skills at a small engineering firm, specializing in composite materials, before transitioning back to motorsport full-time.

Wei’s approach to chief engineering is rooted in methodical analysis and collaborative problem-solving. He believes in empowering his team to contribute their expertise while maintaining a clear vision for the car's development. He emphasizes data-driven decisions, meticulously analyzing telemetry and simulations to identify areas for improvement. Wei is known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that allows him to make rational judgments even in the heat of competition. His innovative thinking, especially with regard to aerodynamic efficiency, sets him apart.

 Wei is considered a rising star in the motorsport engineering world, known for his relentless pursuit of performance gains and his ability to foster a positive and productive team environment. He is always looking for new challenges and opportunities to push the boundaries of motorsport technology.
